review.signOff: Clinical Safety Review Board — Elevate Health
review.changeProcess: Any change to this file requires clinical review and sign-off before merge. Code must not hardcode safety rules outside this artefact.

matching.note: Keywords are compared after the same normalisation applied to patient input (see normalizeForMatch in ai.safety.ts): NFKC, lowercase, smart punctuation folded to ASCII, Arabic diacritics/tatweel stripped, alef/ya/ta-marbuta variants folded, whitespace collapsed. Keywords may therefore be written in natural orthography. Regex patterns are matched against the normalised text, so they MUST be authored in already-normalised form (e.g. 'جرعه', not 'جرعة').

emergency.response: This has been flagged as urgent. Please seek immediate in-person or emergency care now rather than waiting for a written reply.
emergency.responseAr: تم تصنيف رسالتك كحالة عاجلة. يرجى التوجه فوراً لأقرب طوارئ أو طلب رعاية طبية عاجلة الآن وعدم انتظار رد مكتوب.

prohibited.note: Request-shaped patterns only. These detect the patient ASKING for a diagnosis, a medication choice, or a dose — not a patient volunteering history ('I was diagnosed with diabetes', 'my doctor prescribed X last month'), which must still reach normal triage. Note the word boundaries on 'prescribe': without them the pattern also fires on the past tense and declines a patient simply describing their history.
prohibited.response: I can't diagnose conditions, recommend medication, or give dosage instructions — only a licensed doctor examining you can do that. I can help you find the right specialty and book an appointment with a verified doctor on the platform.
prohibited.responseAr: لا أستطيع تشخيص الحالات أو التوصية بأدوية أو تحديد الجرعات، فهذا من اختصاص طبيب مرخّص يفحصك شخصياً. يمكنني مساعدتك في تحديد التخصص المناسب وحجز موعد مع طبيب موثّق على المنصة.

minors.note: The platform stores no date of birth, so age cannot be resolved from the authenticated session. Detection is therefore self-report based and enforced in the system prompt; this artefact is the reviewed source of that wording. If a date-of-birth field is added to the user profile, move this check into a session-identity guard like the appointment capability.
minors.promptRule: If the user states or implies they are under 18 years old, you must tell them a parent or guardian needs to be involved and that they should be seen by a doctor in person, and you must refuse to provide any medical guidance or specialty recommendation.
minors.response: Because you've told me you're under 18, I can't give medical guidance here. Please ask a parent or guardian to help you, and have a doctor see you in person.

fallback.note: Used when post-generation checks strip the entire answer — for example when every sentence named a doctor no capability call returned.
fallback.response: I wasn't able to put together a reliable answer for that. Please browse the verified doctors in the app, or tell me the symptom you're concerned about and I'll point you to the right specialty.

policySnippets.text: Patients can cancel an appointment up to 24 hours in advance without penalty.
Guest users must sign in to view or manage appointments.
Consultation fees are set per doctor-and-clinic pairing and are shown on the doctor's profile before booking is confirmed.
Bookings, reschedules, and cancellations are performed by the patient in the app. The assistant cannot perform them.
